_description: spec/VERIFICATION.md V2-2 boundary: a signed V2 bundle and single-change cases, each bound to the JSON Schema location that decides it. expect.verified is the normative verdict (V2-1 to V2-14): a closed-object or enumeration case is rejected even when every signature and hash is valid, and a verifier that accepts it shows a gap, never conformance. expect.schema is validateV2Bundle (the envelope schema and the four artifact payload schemas); expect.integrity is the SDK-free recomputation of hashes, chain, roots and signatures. Unsigned cases are changed after signing; re-signed cases carry the member under every commitment and signature; stale cases add it after signing. twin names the positive case that carries the same member with every commitment redone: a same-run control besides the base.
_keys: tests/interop/v2/interop_vectors.json#test_keys (TEST-ONLY, publicly known): ed25519 kid c367fd10536963d0787361552bf97e56, ml-dsa-65 kid 504d80c5e8a6527ae9a21fc4a456e9d0; the principal and the agent use the same pair
_randomness: Case construction, timestamps, nonce and Ed25519 signatures are deterministic; ML-DSA-65 signatures are hedged with fresh entropy, so a new run writes different composite_sig.pq.sig_b64 bytes and nothing else. The committed file is the artifact; regeneration is not byte-identical.
